summary: Tested unified reports refactor: backend PDF/Excel exports + JSON base + RBAC (25/25 pytest passed) and frontend Playwright of all 10 report screens. All hero (data-testid=*-hero), report-back-btn, run-report-btn present and functional. Real downloads verified with Arabic X-Filename headers on attendance-overview, teacher-delays, teacher-attendance, course (auto-run via ?id=), teacher-summary. Threshold chips, date controls, tabs (tab-warnings/tab-deprivations, tab-by-teacher/tab-by-lecture, tab-students/tab-lectures) all appear after running the report. No crashes on empty datasets; export buttons hidden when result empty (canExport) as intended.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents) — non-blocking

Console error (non-fatal): 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' emitted on some screens (login redirect, /report-student, /report-lesson-completion). Likely a stray whitespace/string inside a <View> in one of the shared components. Not blocking rendering.

action_items: Clean up React Native Web console warnings: replace shadow* props with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents in ReportShell / hero components.

Investigate 'Unexpected text node' React warning — likely a bare string/space inside a <View> in ReportShell, ReportEmpty, or the student/lesson-completion screens. Non-blocking but should be cleaned.
critical_code_review_comments: PDF endpoints correctly return application/pdf with X-Filename header carrying Arabic-encoded name; downloads verified end-to-end.

RBAC: teacher without export_reports permission correctly gets 403 on /reports/attendance-overview/export-pdf, and can export own /reports/teacher-summary/export-pdf without teacher_id (200) as designed.
canExport gating hides PDF/Excel buttons on empty results (warnings, daily) — this is intentional but may confuse users; consider disabled+tooltip instead.
test account teacher180156 has no linked teacher record (returns 404 on teacher-summary) — used '9999' (حسن صالح) for RBAC teacher tests instead.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 screens loaded; all tested exports downloaded; all interactive testIDs verified)
